reasons: At most 4 MC per semester means only one 4-MC course can be taken in each semester.
From semester 5 to semester 8 there are only 4 available semesters, so at most 4 courses can be planned.

The must-take courses plus required prerequisites total 9 courses: CS2102, CS3231, CS3223, CS2105, CS3233, CS3234, CS4224, CS4226, and CS4430. CS3231 is required before CS4430, CS2102 before CS3223, CS3223 before CS4224, and CS2105 before CS4226.
Therefore no plan can satisfy all rules within semesters 5-8.
